:::{#exm-measure-zero}
#### Sets of measure zero

- For a [counting measure](#def-counting-measure),
  only $\emptyset$ has measure zero:
  a nonempty set has at least one element, so its counting measure is at least $1$.
- For Lebesgue measure,
  every single point $\set{a}$ and the integers $\mathbb{Z}$ have measure zero
  (@exm-lebesgue-measure),
  although neither set is empty.

:::
